risk_note: Admin 用户详情 冻结 / 解冻 / 封禁 / 解封 (apps/admin pages/users/**, texts/users.ts). Contract CT-02j adminUpdateUserRiskState; backend F1-07d merged. Entries by permission point and risk state: risk.freeze gives 【冻结】 on normal users and 【解冻】 on frozen ones, risk.ban gives 【封禁】 on normal / frozen users and 【解封】 on banned ones; banned users get no 【冻结】, appealing users get no entry, accounts without risk.* see none. Freeze takes a reason category (not preselected), a reason and an optional end time read as Beijing time; ban is the same without an end time (orchestrator D10-490, no board); unfreeze / unban take a reason only. A totp step-up for every write; PUT body per action exactly as the contract with expected_row_version from the detail (null without a risk row), no Idempotency-Key, no identity fields; 20902 / 44004 refresh the detail and a failed refresh shows a notice. Hiding the buttons for deleting / deleted users is left as a TODO: AdminUserDetail carries no deletion status (contract gap reported). Prerequisite test-change F1-07ja (#2029) merged; no frozen test changed here. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in two rounds; red/1 failed on an unrecognised red reason (expect.poll), round 2 fixed it and red/2 passed; Claude spec-test review r1 pass (4 S2 fixed in round 2), r2 pass (one S2 carried into the implementation constraints). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (test machine fast and browser green on its tree); after rebasing onto main the container verify-fast hit a tsc heap out-of-memory twice (repository-wide, reported; CI carries an 8 GB heap) while browser stayed green. Adversarial money review by a fresh independent Claude r1 pass with one S2 (the deletion-status contract gap). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, one S2: deleting / deleted users still see the entries because AdminUserDetail has no deletion status (contract gap, TODO in code, reported to the orchestrator); independent Claude because Codex is unavailable until 2026-11-02

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 pass with four S2 (fixed in round 2 together with the expect.poll red-reason problem), round 2 pass with one S2 carried into the implementation constraints; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
